manifest.name: @jcs130/dsh-minecraft-agent
manifest.author: jcs130
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness host adapter for the independent Minecraft SDK, with shared visualization and optional server capability packs.

bundle.text:
# Installing the bundle exposes setup only; connecting requires an explicit configuration.
- insert:
    # Bare package row registers the browser half; its empty config opens no body.
    - id: mc-frontend
      name: '@jcs130/dsh-minecraft-agent'
      config:
        configFile: ''
    - id: mc-harness
      name: '@jcs130/dsh-minecraft-agent/lib/plugins/mc-harness.mjs'
      config:
        configFile: ''
        quickSetup: true

readme.text:
**本批发行 rc.26**：统一消费核心 `0.5.7-rc.153` 与可选千灯纪包 `0.5.0-rc.49`，打包已合入主干的原生回执、任务恢复、历史读取取消，以及旅途中的缺粮观察和决策信号。人格、模型、个人记忆和持续目标继续由 DSH 持有；发行不启动或重载现役角色。下方旧候选及 rc.24 验收是历史记录；本次分发状态见[发布记录](docs/registry-release.md)。

**2026-11-01 本地候选更新**：共享核心补齐长途移动中的缺粮观察与有实际位移的旅途决策机会；单独的普通聊天可以在赶路时发出。食物仍通过原执行器安全插入并续程，宿主不复制另一套自动进食或运动循环。候选未发布到 npm。

**2026-10-28 开发更新**：连接页增加默认开启的「持续自主运行」，同一目标不再因累计 30 次调用或 40 轮停住；安全分段、无进展休整和恢复均保留原会话、目标与回执，手动暂停仍有效。见[持续运行说明](docs/continuous-autonomy.md)。共享核心 rc.115 候选同步上游并修复第一人称空洞、原版皮肤及护甲预览；正式依赖在公开包验收后切换，之前仍保持可安装的 rc.99。

本轮按要求暂不发布 npm 或 GitHub Release，也不重载现役角色。源码和本地候选的验证记录见[本轮说明](docs/autonomy-viewer-20261028.md)；公开安装版本及正式依赖仍沿用下面的 rc.24 / rc.99。

**[0.3.0-rc.24](https://github.com/jcs130/dsh-minecraft-agent/releases/tag/v0.3.0-rc.24) 已发布到 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jcs130/dsh-minecraft-agent)**，latest 指向 rc.24，精确依赖核心 **0.5.7-rc.99** 和可选千灯纪 **0.5.0-rc.24**。核心只读查询可与导航并行，批量消息读回、纠错和记忆去重保留原任务及证据语义。

两版未修改官方 DSH **0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3** 均通过默认 pnpm 公开 registry 安装、主进程／Worker、**38 个 MCP 工具**和真实本地知识库查询；两版各 154 项通过、1 项可选跳过。匿名下载与已验收归档字节一致，见[npm 分发验收](docs/npm-publish-rc24.json)及[本版说明](docs/release-rc24.md)。

没有精确预制材质时仍自动显示兼容画面；普通用户无需手工准备资源。现役角色不因发布重载，原生 Desktop 窗口与真实长期玩法分别验收。旧版 rc.22 及各阶段证据保留，包内候选状态为构建时快照。

新增 [MineDojo 本地知识库配置与检查](docs/minedojo-knowledge.md)：Agent 通过核心 `mc_knowledge` 发现资料源、检索摘要并分页读取，结合当前状态和实际回执决策。先显式准备索引；CPU 词元向量属于词面检索，不冒充神经语义模型。语料、SQLite 和派生向量不随包分发。

包含[配置目标恢复与独立新会话](docs/goal-session-reset.md)、[生存攻略和步骤](docs/survival-decision.md)、[跨版本画面、原版玩家皮肤、公屏与特效开关](docs/viewer-resources-chat.md)。保留游戏旁的 DSH 原生推理／回答／工具会话、指标和实验室。

[角色、皮肤与服务器笔记](docs/character-notebook.md)可配置三个人格预设，矿透默认关闭；用户和 Agent 共用按服务器、账号与维度隔离的轻量笔记与离线检索。安装后复用 DSH 模型，从 Minecraft 侧栏填服务器和角色即可连接；协议默认 auto，普通服务器无需密码。安装本身不连接游戏或启动模型。

见[安装](README-INSTALL.md)和[发布记录](docs/registry-release.md)。npm 与 GitHub 保持原验收归档字节，包内 publication 是构建时快照；当前分发以主干文档及 Release 新增验收附件为准。

同一个 Agent 的游戏连接可以展示第一人称、第三人称和 3D 观战画面，实时查看移动、战斗和环境变化。画面内可开关信息层、调整观察镜头；DSH 面板还可把游戏与原生推理、回答和工具记录并排展示。

上图和下图拍摄于 2026-10-26，来自本插件复用的 **Agent MC World 共享核心线上观战**，不是生成图片或 DSH 桌面窗口。这里展示了服务器自定义地下城；技能和角色外观取决于服务器包及外观资源，不代表所有原版服务器都有这些能力。

第三张是已留证的 DSH Web 集成测试截图：游戏与决策并排，右侧明确标注离线 UI 测试数据，用于展示布局，不冒充真实模型思考或桌面端实测。完整来源见[截图说明](docs/screenshots/README.md)。市场通过根目录 `screenshots.json` 按上述观战优先的顺序读取图片；[市场入口与审核状态](docs/marketplaces.md)单独记录。

`agent-mc-world` 的唯一源码在 [minecraft-ai-friend/packages/agent-mc-world](https://github.com/jcs130/minecraft-ai-friend/tree/main/packages/agent-mc-world)。本插件直接依赖其版本化安装包；构建无需 Cortico World 源码。核心升级先用候选包通过宿主测试，再独立切换部署。

**0.3.0-rc.24 npm / GitHub 发行版** 精确消费核心 **0.5.7-rc.99** 与可选千灯纪 **0.5.0-rc.24**。npm latest 与自有市场入口均为 rc.24。主维护 Java 1.21.1，协议默认 auto；网页材质自动兼容，使用原始官方 DSH。发布、默认安装、原生 Desktop 画面与实服游玩分别留证。

新增可选的 [Harness² 练习接入](docs/harness2.md)，复用 DSH 内置模型路由；默认关闭。显式配置后通过 mc_practice 比较原版、候选及留出场景，结果进入核心的方法库和现有游戏记忆，不自动采用或恢复线上 Agent。

没有 Cortico/N.E.K.O 依赖，不迁入其他角色的人格或记忆。安装本插件不会自动连接。旧 0.1.x 身体只保留在源码及迁移资料，不进入默认构建或发行包。

- Node.js 24，在 DSH 中配置并选择默认模型。安装插件后，点击侧栏 **Minecraft**，填写服务器地址、角色名与登录方式，再点击 **保存并连接游戏**。首次任务可留空，先连接；之后在右侧原生会话里下达任务。无需另填模型密钥或手写 JSON。
- 协议默认 `auto`，交给 Mineflayer 识别服务器，也可显式指定 1.21.11 等受支持版本；正版首次连接需微软授权。已有登录服账号可在可选设置填 `/login` 密码，插件不自动注册账号。千灯纪邀请身份请沿用[专用接入流程](docs/qiandengji-invitation.md)，不能绕过激活直接建号。
- 首次配置保存在当前 DSH profile 的私有目录；同一服务器与身份续用自己的数据和会话，不同身份隔离。**停止并配置**先正常停止本插件的身体，保留目标、会话与记忆，然后允许修改。停止意图会持久化，重启不会擅自恢复。
- 高级部署仍可将 mc-harness 的 configFile 指向私有 JSON，显式设置 enabled、name、dataDir、personaFile、DSH provider/model、contextTokens/maxTokens、minecraft.host/port/username。该路径不受首次配置覆盖。
- `reasoningEffort` 显式传给 DSH 的创建与恢复入口；`off` 表示本轮关闭思考，其他等级以 provider 声明为准。未配置时沿用 DSH 的选择，不暗中降低模型质量。
- [攻略续读与短反思](docs/read-progress.md)：支持新核心时完整正文可分页续读；重复只读证据可触发现有请求的一次短思考，保留日常无思考与原输出预算。
- serverPack 默认 none；千灯纪选择 qiandengji。以当前服务端回执作为事实来源。
- 首次接入自动分配本机端口；高级配置使用 consolePort 和 minecraft.viewerPort。DSH 的 Minecraft 页面组合共享游戏面板和 **DSH 原生会话组件**，可切换游戏 + 决策、只看游戏、只看决策。实际推理默认折叠；模型未返回时不补写。侧栏输入直接进入该身体的原会话，不创建另一个 Agent；会话标签复用宿主已有输入框。/#experiments 可直达共享实验页，/metrics 仍可独立打开。
- 可用 startPaused 设置首次启动暂不连接；之后操作员的连接/断开选择保存在 dataDir/connection-state.json，重启沿用。暂停期间保留会话、目标和记忆，连接后才恢复目标及待投递的操作员指令。
- minecraft.hostDecisions.combat 显式设置 ena

官方 DeepSeek 云端的显式无思考配置见 [provider 示例](examples/harness/deepseek.patch.yml) 和 [Agent 示例](examples/harness/agent.json)。示例安装时不启用，须先填自己的路径、账号与预算。完整说明见 [迁移指南](docs/harness-migration.md)，旧版说明见 [0.1.x 文档](docs/legacy-0.1.md)。

精确依赖已公开，开发使用 `npm ci`、`npm run build`、`npm test`。锁文件保留 registry SemVer 地址与归档完整性，不引入 Git/URL 子依赖。构建生成薄适配器及 DSH 浏览器入口；通用页面、渲染和控制由核心消费的 mc-visual-console 提供。回归包括真实 DSH Session API、模型请求与取消、回合、动作归因、会话面板绑定、暂停持久化、原始官方 DSH 主进程/Worker 加载，以及旧版修复工具的回滚。`MC_DSH_PROFILE` 可将 stock fixture 指向隔离的真实安装 profile，`DSH_RUNTIME` 用于其他宿主 API 测试的外置安装。

主模型工具动作携带真实 session/turn/step 的 `system2` 归因；不把规则动作或影子建议冒充学习策略采用。状态文件显示实际安装的核心和适配器版本、请求的思考等级；流耗时与首字延迟不等于引擎执行耗时。

MIT。data/transmigrators 中鸣人、桐人是第三方虚构角色的演示人格；不附带第三方 YSM 模型。

**2026-10-28 development update:** the Connection tab enables continuous autonomy by default. The same goal continues beyond cumulative 30-call/40-round limits, preserving its session, progress and receipts; safe step boundaries, owned short rests and explicit user pauses remain supported. See the [continuation guide](docs/continuous-autonomy.md). The core rc.115 candidate includes current upstream work and shared first-person, vanilla skin and armor preview fixes. The formal dependency remains installable rc.99 until the replacement public package is verified.

Publication is on hold at the user's request. This source update does not publish npm/GitHub releases or reload live Agents. See the [current verification scope](docs/autonomy-viewer-20261028.md); the published installation below remains rc.24 / core rc.99.

**[0.3.0-rc.24](https://github.com/jcs130/dsh-minecraft-agent/releases/tag/v0.3.0-rc.24) is published on GitHub and [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jcs130/dsh-minecraft-agent)** with npm latest, exact core **0.5.7-rc.99** and optional Qiandengji **0.5.0-rc.24**. Explicit read-only queries can overlap navigation; batch message readback, recovery and memory deduplication preserve task and evidence semantics.

Unmodified official DSH **0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3** passed default public-registry pnpm installation, main/Worker loading, **38 MCP tools** and real local knowledge queries. Each host passed 154 tests with one optional skip. Anonymous archive bytes match the reviewed build. See [npm verification](docs/npm-publish-rc24.json) and [release notes](docs/release-rc24.md). Missing exact materials still use compatible rendering. Publication does not reload live Agents; native Desktop pixels and long-term gameplay remain separate checks. Candidate flags inside the immutable archive are build-time snapshots.

Editable personas, default-off mineral queries, local viewer skins, a shared versioned server notebook and official DSH capability presets are available from the Minecraft settings page. Offline CPU token-vector/keyword retrieval is not a neural semantic model; configure your own embeddings service when needed. Local skins affect the own web avatar only. Existing game, native reasoning/tools, metrics and experiment views remain available. See [configuration and notebook](docs/character-notebook.md), [installation](README-INSTALL.md) and [public verification](docs/npm-publish-rc22.json).

Published archives retain their reviewed bytes. Candidate flags inside the archive are build-time snapshots; Release attachments and main-branch records describe current distribution status. Installation alone starts no game or model.

Watch the Agent's existing game connection in first-person, third-person or 3D spectator views. Toggle the HUD and camera locally; the DSH panel can place the game beside native reasoning, replies and tool records.

Captured on 2026-10-26 from the shared **Agent MC World** core's existing live spectator page, not an AI-generated image or a DSH Desktop window. This server has custom dungeon content; its skills and character appearance depend on optional server/appearance resources.

The third image is a recorded DSH Web integration test. The transcript is visibly labelled offline UI test data; it demonstrates the layout, not live model reasoning. See [screenshot provenance](docs/screenshots/README.md), [Desktop installation](docs/desktop.md) and [market listing status](docs/marketplaces.md). The root `screenshots.json` provides the gallery in this order.

A thin DeepSeek Harness adapter for the shared [Agent MC World core](https://github.com/jcs130/minecraft-ai-friend/tree/main/packages/agent-mc-world). DSH owns persona, goals, sessions, memory and model choice. The core owns one Minecraft body, navigation, tools, game memory, learning evidence, fast-decision contracts and visualization. The optional `agent-mc-qiandengji` package enables that server's protocols and reference material explicitly.

The rc.24 release consumes core **0.5.7-rc.99** and optional pack **0.5.0-rc.24**. Java 1.21.1 is primary; actual connection protocols and compatible viewer materials remain explicit. Publication, installation, native Desktop pixels and live gameplay are separate acceptance stages.

The default lean tool set now retains `*_script` for on-demand shared routine and method discovery; explicit `tools.exclude` is respected.

Optional [Harness2 practice](docs/harness2.md) reuses DSH's registered model route and the core's isolated execution, baseline/held-out comparison and game-memory contracts. It is disabled by default and never adopts a skill or resumes a live Agent automatically.

Use Node.js 24. The first-run form reuses DSH's selected provider, model and reasoning effort, allocates local ports and keeps a private per-account data directory. An empty first task connects without starting inference. The right pane renders DSH's original reasoning, tools and replies; game-only mode hides the transcript for streaming. Missing reasoning stays unavailable. Stop and configure preserves the session and persists the stopped state. Advanced deployments may still use a private `configFile`; see [examples](examples/harness). Local and cloud models use the same body and public SDK/MCP interface. Microsoft authentication and server-specific activation remain explicit steps.

An existing session resumes with its original identity, goals and history. The adapter preserves structured receipts, task terminal states, cancellation and real DSH turn boundaries. Model actions carry actual session/turn/step attribution. Shadow suggestions are not counted as adopted learned actions. Client stream duration is not engine execution time, and unavailable metrics remain unknown.

The exact dependencies are public: use `npm ci`, `npm run build` and `npm test`. All locked dependencies use registry.npmjs.org with integrity metadata. Tests cover native DSH sessions, loopback model formatting/cancellation, stock official main/Worker loading and legacy repair rollback. `MC_DSH_PROFILE` targets an isolated installed profile for the stock fixture; `DSH_RUNTIME` selects an external host for other API tests. The build copies only the adapter; it does not bundle another body or import a Cortico checkout.

See the [migration guide](docs/harness-migration.md) and [installation guide](README-INSTALL.md). The old 0.1.x implementation is retained as [legacy reference](docs/legacy-0.1.md) and excluded from the default release.

MIT. Demonstration personas reference fictional third-party characters; no third-party YSM model is distributed.
